• Supervise the General Services Manager of UBP HK and other staff of the department.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission We are seeking an experienced Fixed Income Execution Trader to join our team in Geneva. For this full-time position, a solid background in bond markets, advanced execution skills and the ability to perform in a fast-paced environment is requested. Individual’s role will focus on day-to-day execution of fixed income orders in primary and secondary markets, optimizing execution strategies, and contributing to the automation of order workflows. The candidate is expected to be learning and supporting execution in other asset classes and take part to late shift coverage for US markets (up to 22:00).
• Main responsibilities
• Efficient and accurate trade execution (voice and electronic) in secondary markets (Credit IG and HY, Rates, Emerging Markets, Money Markets).
• Oversee full bookbuilding processes in primary markets (publish new issues, collect subscriptions, distribute allocations)
• Play an integral part of a ‘value added’ basis to investment process by leveraging market knowledge and counterparty contacts to improve performance and influence outcomes
• Monitor and share market news and liquidity conditions with Wealth Management teams and build trust-based internal relationships
• Develop and maintain strong, transparent and constructive relationships with brokers and counterparties to obtain the best service for the bank’s clients
• Run and optimize electronic execution and RFQs via Bloomberg (e.g., IB/TSOX), MarketAxess, and Tradeweb
• Develop and implement Fixed Income execution strategies to optimize trading performance and client outcomes
• Contribute to the automation of bond order workflows and the integration of trading technologies
• Late-shift coverage (up to 22:00): mandatory multi-asset execution across Fixed Income, Equities, and ETDs
• Ensure strict compliance with internal policies and external regulatory requirements (e.g., best execution, record-keeping)
• Your Profile
• Experience : Minimum of 5 years trading experience in Fixed Income primary and secondary markets with a proven track record
• Product Knowledge : Deep understanding of Fixed Income products and market structure, liquidity dynamics, RFQ protocols, and new issue processes
• Trading Venues and Platforms : Hands-on experience executing via Bloomberg (IB/TSOX), MarketAxess, and Tradeweb; extensive use of InvestorAccess and DirectBooks for new issues
• Execution Skills: Strong voice trading and e-trading capabilities; familiarity with auto-routing, dealer selection, and best-ex filters.
• Languages: Fluency in English and French is a prerequisite.
• Technology: Advanced Excel; VBA and/or Python are a strong advantage, particularly for automating bond workflows and reporting.
• Versatility: Willingness to learn and execute another asset class as needed; ability to switch between tools and processes.
• Stress Management: Ability to perform under pressure in a high-stakes, fast-paced environment.
• Attention to Detail: Exceptional accuracy in execution, allocations, and post-trade reporting.
• Passion for Markets: Genuine enthusiasm for Fixed Income and trading innovation.
• Core Competencies
• Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility.
• Strong commitment to compliance with regulations and internal directives.
• Proactive mindset with a focus on continuous improvement and team collaboration.
• Others
• Swiss Residence is required

• Mission As part of the Tax Services team, the Tax Specialist is a key element to ensure the quality and accuracy of the reporting done by the Bank, as a regulatory obligation, in an environment which is subject to constant changes and evolutions. Within the Daily Regulatory Reporting team, the employee’s mission also includes constant monitoring and reconciliation of the data to be reported. The tax and regulatory topics include MIFID II/ EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG / Duty to disclose.
• Main responsibilities
• Daily monitoring and control of regulatory reporting (MIFID II / EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG) sent to the reporting platform(s) (i.e. locals regulators)
• Monthly reconciliations, quality control and statistics of the data reported
• Manage inquiries and investigate questions and issues about the taxes or regulatory reporting from other departments of the Bank or from external counterparties
• Understand regulatory risk sensitivity and has an end-to-end view of the Bank’s flow/process
• Correction of consistency issues, update reporting tool’s database
• Liaising and coordinating with the department responsible for the underlying data for the necessary corrections, explanations, data input and resubmission of the corrected report(s)
• Communication with the reporting engine providers (ARM, APA, TR)
• Performing regular and ad-hoc reporting related to statistics for internal and external parties
• Contribute to all testing linked to regulatory and reporting updates
• Active participation in EMIR/MIFID/DTD projects (Audit inquiries, Provider specifications changes & Regulator inquiries) including data mining and in-depth investigation
• Open mind and team orientation: Be open to other’s ideas. Express and accept constructive criticism.
• Innovation and development: Propose and seek improvement of the current tools and processes. Be positive towards change and seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment. Conitunuously work on knowledge improvement.
• Corporate culture: Be ‘solution oriented’ and have a strong sense of customer services. Be proactive and driven. Developp and maintain a relationship network within the various Bank departments. Comply consistently with internal and external regulations.
• Your Profile
• Good knowledge of the financial products and associated transactions
• 3-5 years of experience in banking or financial services
• Project management experience
• Strong Excel, Access skills
• Strong analytical skills, able to make complex data reconciliation
• Ability to efficiently manage priorities
• Be able to work independently but also as a team
• Seek opportunities to improve the existing set-up
• Go beyond specific assignments, walk the extra mile
• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations
• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures
• Fluent in French and English
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Mission Based in our main office in Geneva, you will join the Global Service Desk team, providing first-line support to approximately 3,000 Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) colleagues worldwide. Main responsibilities
• Answer to the Global Service Desk phone line for all UBP users worldwide.
• Manage emails sent to Global Service Desk.
• Manage workload from our self-ticketing tool.
• Provide remote assistance to users and try to resolve the problem on first call.
• Create incidents with clear and explicit information and assign to level 2 teams if necessary.
• Knowledge documentation and procedures updates.
• Working hours: Weekdays, shift coverage from 07:30 to 19:00. Your Profile
• Help Desk Institute Certification (CFC) or equivalent.
• A first successful experience in a Help Desk service is mandatory.
• Microsoft Operating System Certification(s) will be an asset.
• ITIL Foundation Certification will be an asset.
• Expertise in Microsoft Windows 11 and Microsoft 365 (Office 365)
• Experience with Citrix and VDI environments and with Remote Access connection (RSA Secure ID, Citrix Workspace).
• Knowledge of, Active Directory, GPO, SCCM, Networking.
• Knowledge on Mobility: iOS and iPhone, iPad.
• JIRA service management tool knowledge.
• Fluent in French and English; additional languages considered an asset. Competencies
• Excellent analytical thinking and problem-solving skills.
• Excellent oral and written communication skills.
• Highly customer service oriented.

descriptionByLocale.it:
Mission Through the Asset Management division, we offer to institutional clients’ investment management capabilities organised across the business lines Long-Only Platform, Alternative Investment Solutions, Private Markets Group, Partnerships, Asset Allocation & DPM. The Institutional Client Service Team serves as the primary contact for large and complex institutional clients globally, supporting sales teams in engaging institutional and wholesale clients. The team plays a vital role in enhancing profitability and driving growth within the Asset Management business. We are seeking a dynamic candidate with a strong interest in Asset Management to join the Institutional Client Service team in Frankfurt . This role involves close collaboration with the German sales team, reporting locally to the Head of Wholesale EMEA and centrally to the COO - Institutional Clients & Head of the Client Service Team. The position covers activities with both institutional and wholesale clients in the DACH region (Germany, German-speaking Switzerland, and Austria) This position is for 12 months, but it may be renewed or offer other opportunities. Main responsibilities
• Assist Asset Management Sales teams in supporting German-speaking client-base.
• Manage, execute, and follow up on client requests and inquiries.
• Collaborate with internal teams throughout the client lifecycle to ensure client satisfaction and retention.
• Coordinate the onboarding process and oversee the end-to-end transition.
• Involve in the implementation and monitoring of the local sales strategy.
• Support the team in their prospecting initiatives, including the preparation of marketing materials and conducting market research.
• Contribute to the optimization of processes through the application of AI technologies.
• Act as the local CRM champion, supporting and training the sales team to meet Salesforce requirements and ensure data accuracy.
• Organise local events and roadshows.
• Perform office management tasks. Your Profile
• Bachelor’s degree in business administration, Marketing, or a related field is beneficial.
• Excellent organizational skills and capability to work independently.
• Accuracy and attention to detail.
• Advanced skills in standard IT applications (MS Office).
• Mother tongue German and fluency in English is a “MUST”; French is a “nice to have”. Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is a family-owned company, driven by an entrepreneurial vision, innovation and independence. UBP is one of the most strongly-capitalised private banks. By joining UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. you will embrace a team of supportive high qualified professionals in Private Banking that will lead you to develop your career to the top level. We encourage continuous learning, development and knowledge sharing. We foster a culture of Agility, Conviction, Dedication and high degree of Responsibility. UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A encourages all suitable qualified and eligible candidates to apply regardless of their gender identity or expression, age, racial, ethnic and cultural background, religion and beliefs, sexual orientation, disability or neurodiversity. In accordance with the provisions of the Luxembourg law of 23 July 2016 amending the law of 29 March 2013, retained candidate will be required to provide an extract from their criminal record as a part of UBP screening process.

• Mission As a Senior Legal Advisor specialized in investment funds, you will play a central role within UBP Management Company, UBP Asset Management (Europe) S.A. You will be involved in a broad range of fund related legal and regulatory matters, including regulatory compliance, fund governance, and structuring of new products. You will work closely with all stakeholders of the Management Company, providing legal expertise to support the company’s strategic and operational activities. You will also collaborate daily with our Product Management team and actively contributing to the structuring, management, and evolution of investment products. This key role will allow you to work on diverse projects and collaborate with multidisciplinary teams in a dynamic and international environment. You will also be in charged of the corporate governance of the _Management Company and its branches.
• Your main responsibilities will be:
• Legal Advice :
• Provide legal advice on the company’s activities, particularly in corporate law, investment fund law, and financial law.
• Ensure the company’s activities comply with local and European regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).
• Draft, review, and negotiate contracts, partnership agreements, management mandates, and other legal documents.
• Collaboration with the Product Management Team:
• Work closely with the Product Management team on the structuring, implementation, and management of investment products.
• Provide legal support for the development of new products and the update of existing ones.
• Fund Management:
• Oversee the creation, structuring, and legal management of investment funds (UCITS, AIF, SICAV, FIS, RAIF, etc.).
• Prepare and update legal documentation for funds (prospectus, articles of association, management regulations, etc.).
• Manage relationships with regulatory authorities (CSSF) and follow up on regulatory requests.
• Compliance and Regulatory Monitoring :
• Conduct legal and regulatory monitoring to anticipate legislative changes and their impact on the company’s activities.
• Collaborate with the compliance team to ensure adherence to legal and regulatory obligations.
• Litigation Management :
• Handle potential disputes in collaboration with external law firms.
• Defend the company’s interests in litigation or judicial proceedings.
• Training and Support:
• Train and raise awareness among internal teams about regulatory developments and best legal practices.
• Provide legal support to various departments within the company.
• Your Profile:
• Master’s degree in Business Law, Corporate Law, or Financial Law.
• Specialization in investment fund law or financial law is an asset.
• 5 to 10 years of experience as a legal counsel in a Management Company, law firm, or financial institution in Luxembourg.
• Proved experience in managing investment funds (UCITS, AIF, etc.).
• Excellent knowledge of corporate law, investment fund law, and Luxembourg and European financial regulations (CSSF, AIFMD, UCITS, etc.).
• Proficiency in the processes of structuring and managing investment funds.
• Ability to draft and negotiate complex contracts in both French and English.
• Strong organizational skills and attention to detail.
• Excellent analytical and synthesis skills.
• Ability to work independently while effectively collaborating with multidisciplinary teams.
• Excellent written and verbal communication skills.

We are offering an exceptional opportunity for a recent master’s graduate to join our exclusive programme, designed to provide in-depth exposure to Wealth Management at a renowned Private Bank. The programme offers a comprehensive learning experience, enabling you to gain valuable insights into the finance industry and develop essential skills for a successful career in private banking. The graduate programme consists of 3 rotations each lasting 4 months. These rotations take place in different teams, all closely connected to Wealth Management and Treasury and Trading, providing an excellent opportunity to build a broad internal network of colleagues and experts. Furthermore, you will benefit from shadowing experiences, gaining valuable exposure to various aspects of the bank’s operation. This programme is specifically designed for young graduates holding a master’s degree, with a maximum of 12 months of professional experience since graduation. Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) – Wealth Management: Union Bancaire Privée (UBP) is one of the largest family-owned private banks in the world. But what makes UBP unique is its corporate culture, which combines modernity and tradition. Although UBP was founded in 1969, its origins can be traced back to the 17th century and the start of a long line of financiers and diplomats of whom Edgar de Picciotto and his descendants are the successors. Today, the Bank's staff draw their inspiration and drive from the founding family's subtle blend of strong moral values and pragmatism, which to this day remain the key to UBP’s success. As it plays such a major part in our strategy, we are investing significantly in Wealth Management to fuel our growth, particularly in Europe, the Middle East, Eastern Europe, Latin America, and Asia. We provide a complete range of private banking products and services, including a variety of investment management and advisory mandates, tailored to our clients’ specific requirements, objectives, and risk profiles. Among UBP professional partners, over 300 independent asset managers have chosen us as their custodian bank, valuing our personalised, flexible services and our transparent fee structure. • Relationship with private clients and marketing

• Mission The Invoice Officer in Accounts Payable is responsible for the accurate processing of invoices and ensuring timely payments to vendors (approximately 350 invoices per month). This role involves maintaining financial records, resolving discrepancies, and supporting the overall account payable function. The Invoice Officer will also collaborate closely with IT procurement and business IT partners to enhance operational efficiency and ensure alignment with financial practices.
• Main responsibilities include but not limited to : 1. Invoice Processing: - Review and verify invoices for accuracy and completeness. - Enter invoices into the information system (Coupa/Dynamics Navision) and ensure proper coding. - Participate in projects focused on processes transformation 2. Payment Processing: - Prepare and process payment runs. - Monitor payment schedules and ensure timely payments to vendors. 3. Vendor Management: - Communicate with vendors regarding invoice status and payment inquiries. - Assist in resolving any disputes or discrepancies. 4. Record Keeping: - Maintain accurate and organized accounts payable records. - Prepare and manage monthly accruals to ensure accurate financial reporting and compliance with accounting standards. - Provide detailed business allocation of depreciation for projects - Ensure all invoices are filed according to company policy. 5. Reporting: - Assist in generating accounts payable reports for management review. - Support month-end closing activities related to accounts payable. - Provide detailed report related to mobile communication costs on a quarterly basis. 6. Compliance: - Ensure compliance with company policies and accounting standards. - Assist in audits by providing necessary documentation and information.
• Qualifications:
• Associate’s or Bachelor’s degree in Accounting, Finance, or a related field preferred.
• Previous experience in accounts payable or a similar role is mandatory.
• Previous experience with Coupa and MS Dynamics is preferable
• Proficient in accounting software and Microsoft Office Suite.
• Excellent attention to detail and accuracy in data entry and financial reporting.
• Proficient verbal and written communication skills in both French and English for effective collaboration with vendors and internal teams.
• Ability to work independently and as part of a team.
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it: Mission The Central Vault officer is responsible for the management, security and operations of the precious metals vault and physical certificates including security and traceability of all assets entering and leaving the vault. He is working within our institution procedural guidelines to ensure a high quality of service is consistently maintained, with optimum efficiency and all standard operating procedures and Key Performance Indicators being adhered to. He will be working closely with internal management on the strategic global growth of our projects; offering products and services combined into innovative offerings and operational knowledge. Essential Duties Vault main tasks - Places, and fulfills orders from the Private Banking / Clients to maintain required levels of precious metal available in the vault - Ensure physical delivery to Relationship manager and Clients - Handling receipts and deliveries of physical securities and metals - Maintains internal procedures up to date in regards with the security and regulations of the Bank’s vault. - Performs inventory maintenance, verification and accounting entries with reconciliation department - Performs, confirms and maintains banking insurances according to the vault valuation. Trading tasks - Processes, monitors and validates precious metals and private placement - Ensure good receipt of Private Equity subscription and redemption proceeds with external funds managers - Reconciliation and monitoring of holdings, entitlements determination, pending positions - Ensure daily proper record-keeping and development of new activities/business with external providers in regards with vault activities. Supervisory Responsibility - Coordinates and manages Vault activities at all bank branches - Ensure allocation to client accounts and physical securities settlement - Precious metals receiving - Receives and verifies vault deposits, inspects the integrity of bags and seals and notifies management of exceptions. - Ensure follow-up with private company to maintain self-evaluation of private equity - Perform procedures for opening and closing of operations, including vault, alarm and door duties - Ensure that security/control procedures are correctly performed in accordance with established policies Specific competencies - Strong knowledge on financial instruments (equities, bonds, warrants, private placements, restricted securities, funds and other), and their operating flows - Sense of risk associated with the delivery and receipt of securities - Flexibility, adaptation to change - Strong analytical skills with an ability to identify problems and propose solutions. - Sense of priorities and capacity to take decisions - Consistently comply with internal & external regulation Skills and Abilities - Technical knowledge of detailed domain (Compliance and legal competencies appreciated) - CFC bank or equivalent - Fluency in English and French - Experience of at least 5 years in a similar position - Discretion and excellent presentation - MS Office / Banking software / Swift Business daily contacts - Clients - Private Banking - Operations department / Treasury & Trading - Compliance department / Legal department - IT - Banks / Transfer Agents/ Brokers / Custodians / Funds managers Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Permanent position with a 12-months rotational program within different teams to discover different activities, as well as build expertise and professional skills.
• Rotation 1 – [Business Management Team for 9 months]
• Rotation 2 – [Investment Services Team for 3 months]
• During the program, under supervision of the Head of CE Office as mentor, the Graduate is expected to:
• Get familiar with the organization structure, the roles and responsibilities of different functional teams and the usage of the Bank’s core systems
• Rotate between business management, front office sales team and Investment Services team to learn the key tasks and responsibilities
• The rotation in the business management team will be focus on:
• Support project management: Learn to collaborate with the team on various projects relates to process improvement, operational efficiency, and Front Office risk management
• Coordinate meeting and presentation, including preparing meeting agenda, coordinating schedules, and taking meeting minutes
• Housekeeping: progress and status tracking in client portfolio review, cross-border travel report, and maintain the Business Introducer list
• Daily routine monitoring task in the Business Management Team
• Coordinate in project UAT / Testing arrangement
• The Graduate will be attached to Assistants of Private Banker to learn the daily tasks carried out in the Front Office, e.g. selling process, order taking from client, handling remittance, account maintenance etc.
• Main responsibilities in the Investment Services Team:
• The Graduate will be attached to various investment/product specialist to learn about the products offering from the bank, e.g. Equity, Fixed Income, Mutual Funds, Structured Products and Alternative Investments, and the key products features and characteristics of these products
• The Graduate will learn from the Advisory team on engaging private client for investment products
• At the end of all rotations, the Graduate is expected to be fully trained in:
• Front Office practices and requirements
• Products and services offered in Private Banking
• Business Management for Private Banking Front Office
• Professional organizational behaviour and conduct in an international Private Bank
• Starting Date: September 2026 Rationale – Why Business Management Team in Private Bank? Joining Business Management team in a Private Bank can be a valuable opportunity to kickstart the Graduate’s career in the Finance industry. For example:
• Practical experience and exposure: Private Banks are at the forefront of the financial industry and the exposures in the Business Management team offers the Graduate get into the inner working of how a private bank operates. The Graduate will gain a comprehensive understanding of the banking operations, risk management, compliance, and client services. This exposure will help the Graduate develop a solid foundation of knowledge and provide a first-hand understanding of the dynamics of the financial sector.
• Skill developments: The internship in a business management team allows the Graduate to develop and enhance essential skills that are highly valued in the finance industry. For example, project management skills, problem solving skills, communication skills, and teamwork etc.
• Networking opportunities: Due to the nature of Business Management team which connects the Front Offices to all the functional team in the middle and back offices, it opens doors to networking opportunities. The Graduate will have the chance to interact with professionals from various departments within the bank, including Bankers, senior executives, investment advisors, COO and Compliance etc. Building relationship with these important individuals can be invaluable, as they can provide guidance, mentorship, and potential future job opportunities. Candidates with, at minimum, a bachelor's degree (or in the final-year study) and, no more than 12 months of full-time post-graduate work experience are welcome to apply.

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission
• The mission consists in performing the role of IT business analyst for Risk applications, in particular for subjects related to Balance Sheet Management, Value At Risk (VaR), Reconciliation and IRRBB / CSRBB regulations.
• The candidate needs to have an extensive IT risk management banking background as well as a strong BA experience.
• Main responsibilities
• Reporting to the Team Lead of IT Risk, Credit & ESG, the consultant will work on risk application projects.
• IT BA Responsibilities
• Analyse regulation, business scenarios/cases and contribute to business / regulatory requirements definition.
• Eg : Impact of products evolution (Acumulator / Decumulator, Deposits, Credit and Mortgages) on the Balance Sheet Management (BSM) IT treatment
• Define Functional Design Specification.
• Manage vendor (FIS) application relationship (software package).
• Execute database scripts and queries (SQL) to validate data integrity and ensure alignment with regulatory requirements.
• Install and test new versions of BSM and VaR Hedge Funds Applications and exploit the applications in production (batch error management).
• Liaise with the business to provide guidance from an IT point of view.
• Provide guidance for business analysts, developers, and testers assigned to the projects and ensure good project management practices are employed throughout the project lifecycle.
• Identify key risks and issues and define mitigation scenarios.
• Your Profile
• 5 to 10 years of experience
• Education : Master Degree in IT
• Experience required
• IT Business Analyst with strong technical and functional skills on Risk Management – FIS Balance Sheet Manager – Var HF & Reconciliation (based on MATLAB)
• Proficient in SQL and database scripting for risk data analytics.
• Good understanding of the bank’s business processes
• Good operational experience in the implementation of various IT Risk Management projects in banking or financial sectors related to risk management, VaR reconciliation, IRRBB (Interest Rate Risk in the Banking Book) / CSRBB (Credit Spread Risk in the Banking Book) regulations.
• Good practrice of IT BA activities and knowledge of IT project management
• Languages:
• French mandatory and English (C1)
• Others
• Swiss residency: Optional

descriptionByLocale.it:
• Mission As part of the Tax Services team, the Tax Specialist is a key element to ensure the quality and accuracy of the reporting done by the Bank, as a regulatory obligation, in an environment which is subject to constant changes and evolutions. Within the Daily Regulatory Reporting team, the employee’s mission also includes constant monitoring and reconciliation of the data to be reported. The tax and regulatory topics include MIFID II/ EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG / Duty to disclose.
• Main responsibilities
• Daily monitoring and control of regulatory reporting (MIFID II / EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG) sent to the reporting platform(s) (i.e. locals regulators)
• Monthly reconciliations, quality control and statistics of the data reported
• Manage inquiries and investigate questions and issues about the taxes or regulatory reporting from other departments of the Bank or from external counterparties
• Understand regulatory risk sensitivity and has an end-to-end view of the Bank’s flow/process
• Correction of consistency issues, update reporting tool’s database
• Liaising and coordinating with the department responsible for the underlying data for the necessary corrections, explanations, data input and resubmission of the corrected report(s)
• Communication with the reporting engine providers (ARM, APA, TR)
• Performing regular and ad-hoc reporting related to statistics for internal and external parties
• Contribute to all testing linked to regulatory and reporting updates
• Active participation in EMIR/MIFID/DTD projects (Audit inquiries, Provider specifications changes & Regulator inquiries) including data mining and in-depth investigation
• Open mind and team orientation: Be open to other’s ideas. Express and accept constructive criticism.
• Innovation and development: Propose and seek improvement of the current tools and processes. Be positive towards change and seek opportunities to improve the quality of the working environment. Conitunuously work on knowledge improvement.
• Corporate culture: Be ‘solution oriented’ and have a strong sense of customer services. Be proactive and driven. Developp and maintain a relationship network within the various Bank departments. Comply consistently with internal and external regulations.
• Your Profile
• Good knowledge of the financial products and associated transactions
• 3-5 years of experience in banking or financial services
• Project management experience
• Strong Excel, Access skills
• Strong analytical skills, able to make complex data reconciliation
• Ability to efficiently manage priorities
• Be able to work independently but also as a team
• Seek opportunities to improve the existing set-up
• Go beyond specific assignments, walk the extra mile
• Consistently comply with internal & external regulations
• Maintain quality standards despite schedule pressures
• Fluent in French and English
• Others
• Swiss Residence Core Competencies : Adherence to the company’s values: Dedication, Conviction, Agility and Responsibility - Compliance with regulations and internal directives

Within the Daily Regulatory Reporting team, the employee’s mission also includes constant monitoring and reconciliation of the data to be reported. The tax and regulatory topics include MIFID II/ EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG / Duty to disclose.

• Main responsibilities
• Daily monitoring and control of regulatory reporting (MIFID II / EMIR / FMIA / FINFRAG) sent to the reporting platform(s) (i.e. locals regulators)

• Monthly reconciliations, quality control and statistics of the data reported

• Manage inquiries and investigate questions and issues about the taxes or regulatory reporting from other departments of the Bank or from external counterparties

• Understand regulatory risk sensitivity and has an end-to-end view of the Bank’s flow/process

• Correction of consistency issues, update reporting tool’s database

• Liaising and coordinating with the department responsible for the underlying data for the necessary corrections, explanations, data input and resubmission of the corrected report(s)

• Communication with the reporting engine providers (ARM, APA, TR)

• Performing regular and ad-hoc reporting related to statistics for internal and external parties

• Contribute to all testing linked to regulatory and reporting updates

• Active participation in EMIR/MIFID/DTD projects (Audit inquiries, Provider specifications changes & Regulator inquiries) including data mining and in-depth investigation

descriptionByLocale.en: Mission We are seeking a motivated and detail-oriented Tax Specialist to join our Client Documentation and Tax Services Department. As part of the Fiscal Reporting team, you will play a key role in ensuring the accuracy and quality of our clients’ tax statements, while collaborating with various departments and external providers. This is a unique opportunity to grow in a fast-paced, stimulating environment and contribute to impactful projects across the bank. Main Responsibilities Tax Statement Review & Validation - Review and validate tax statements for over 20 international jurisdictions, including Switzerland, France, Portugal, Mexico, and others. - Ensure that tax documents comply with local and international regulations before being sent to clients. Data Quality Assurance - Collaborate with our external provider to ensure the quality and accuracy of tax data before statement production. - Identify and correct anomalies or inconsistencies in the data to ensure reliable reporting. Client Support & Front Office Interaction - Address inquiries and requests from the Front Office regarding tax statements, providing clear and precise explanations. - Manage tax document orders in coordination with internal teams and external providers. Cross-Functional Collaboration - Work closely with Compliance, Operations, Front Office, and IT teams to ensure smooth management of tax processes. - Actively participate in cross-functional projects involving process improvements, regulatory updates, or strategic initiatives. Project Management - Contribute to side projects related to tax data, information systems, and operational processes. - Participate in the continuous improvement of tools and processes in collaboration with IT and other departments. Regulatory Compliance & Reporting - Stay updated on tax regulatory changes across the covered jurisdictions. - Prepare detailed reports and maintain comprehensive documentation to meet audit and regulatory requirements. Key Skills & Qualifications • Tax Expertise : In-depth knowledge of international tax regulations. • Analytical Skills : Ability to analyze complex data and identify anomalies. • Client Orientation : Excellent communication skills to address Front Office and client inquiries. • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Experience working with multidisciplinary teams (Compliance, IT, Operations, etc.). • Project Management : Ability to manage multiple projects simultaneously and meet deadlines. What We're Looking For • Experience : Minimum 2 years in banking, with a focus on tax services. • Skills : Strong knowledge of financial instruments (Equities, Bonds, Structured Products, Derivatives – Listed or OTC) and their specific characteristics. Familiarity with European income and gains taxation is a plus. Proficiency in Microsoft Office is essential. • Languages : Fluency in French and English is required; German, Italian, Spanish, or Portuguese is a plus. • Mindset : Proactive, solution-oriented, and eager to learn. Strong problem-solving skills, ability to work quickly and efficiently, and a team player who thrives in a fast-paced environment. Why Join Us? • Be part of a collaborative and innovative team. • Work in a challenging yet rewarding environment. • Develop your expertise and grow your career in a leading financial institution. If you’re ready to take on this exciting challenge and make a long-term impact, we’d love to hear from you!
